outcome: Reads an original logical key outcome from the provider store without executing providers again.
outcome.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
outcome.idempotencyKey: Original application-issued key used for the same earlier logical operation.

announceClose: Announces a bounded drain window to one peer while leaving actual physical close with its owning adapter.
announceClose.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
announceClose.options: Caller drainMs duration and optional receiverId from discovery; this is a relative peer announcement.

ping: Checks one actual receiver liveness; requires installed ping capability and actual negotiated support.
ping.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
ping.receiverId: Specific receiver identifier returned by discovery candidates or connect.getServerList; never invent an instance address.
ping.options: Optional IRpcPingOptions with local signal and deadline override.
Promise<boolean> for the observed reply; disposal settles an active ping as false. Calling after disposal or without ping capability throws its coded error. Ping cancellation does not require abort middleware.
pingAll: Checks liveness of the statically configured target seeds and retains individual success/failure results.

connect: Connection/discovery controls derived from the actual middleware tuple; manual mode exposes query and registration operations.
discovery: Read-only candidate listing and explicit receiver pin controls sharing the canonical discovery owner.
hooks: Local diagnostic subscription facade; hooks.on receives IRpcHookEvent and returns an unsubscriber.

scheduler: Application monotonic IScheduler shared by endpoint deadlines and PluginHost; now must be finite nonnegative milliseconds.
systemScheduler uses host monotonic time and timers.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
config: Application IRpcFactoryConfig whose actual protocol/codec/framer/transport types satisfy both directed pipeline edges; middlewares is the actual finite installation tuple.
Promise of the selected endpoint surface; invalid inputs fail before publication, failed construction rolls back and preserves original/cleanup causes. An unclassified middleware install failure gains CALLBACK_FAILED without replacing mutable native type/stack; foreign semantic identities stay intact and immutable values remain on cause.
provide: Registers one provider for a unique method name; duplicate registration throws PROVIDER_DUPLICATED.
provide.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
provide.provider: Application callback receives IRpcContext and returns context.success or context.failed synchronously or asynchronously. Legacy ordinary throws usually become INTERNAL; trusted wire summaries and SCHEMA_INVALID retain public classification. Runtime operations serialize the original failure.
The same endpoint for chaining; disposal rejects new registrations.
on: Registers a one-way event listener; callbacks receive IRpcContext and async failures are observed through endpoint hooks.
on.event: Application event name matching the sender dispatch method.
on.listener: Application callback receives IRpcContext, returns void or Promise<void>, and should not retain expired response operations.
Idempotent unsubscriber removes only this registration.
send: Sends a correlated scalar request to the selected receiver and waits for one actual provider result.
send.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
send.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
send.data: Application request payload validated by the installed contract/codec.
send.options: Optional ISendOptions supplied by the caller; timeout, cancellation, transfer, idempotency and trace remain explicit.
Promise of provider data; remote business failure, cancellation, deadline, transport or lifecycle failure rejects with its native coded error. A synchronous UUID admission failure releases operation signal listeners; ordinary send cancellation keeps RpcAbortError.
sendAll: Sends the same scalar method to the statically configured target seeds and keeps each target success/failure separately.
sendAll.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
sendAll.data: Application payload sent independently to every selected target.
sendAll.options: Caller ISendOptions applied to the selected fan-out operations.
IRpcFanoutResult maps receiver/target keys to fulfilled data or original rejected errors.
dispatch: Sends a legacy one-way event without awaiting business completion; pair with on on the receiving endpoint.
dispatch.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
dispatch.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
dispatch.data: Application event payload for the receiving listener.
Returns void once dispatch is initiated; failures are contained in endpoint hooks.
dispatchAll: Dispatches one event to the statically configured target seeds without waiting for business listeners.
dispatchAll.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
dispatchAll.data: Application event payload for each selected target.
Returns void after scheduling selected dispatches; hooks observe failures.
group: Reserves every request-only step before execution, then runs in order until first failure; successful earlier effects are not rolled back.
group.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
group.steps: Application nonempty method/payload array admitted as IRpcRuntimeGroupSteps.
group.options: Optional IRpcRuntimeGroupOptions with actual ordering/cancellation/idempotency and local send controls.
Promise of actual step outcomes; unsupported native group capability rejects before dispatch.
outcome: Reads an original logical key outcome from the provider store without executing providers again.
outcome.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
outcome.idempotencyKey: Original application-issued key used for the same earlier logical operation.
IRpcRuntimeOutcomeResult reports pending/done/unknown and store continuity; unknown never proves nonexecution.
announceClose: Announces a bounded drain window to one peer while leaving actual physical close with its owning adapter.
announceClose.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
announceClose.options: Caller drainMs duration and optional receiverId from discovery; this is a relative peer announcement.
Resolves when the close control is sent; it does not await remote resource disposal.
ping: Checks one actual receiver liveness; requires installed ping capability and actual negotiated support.
ping.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
ping.receiverId: Specific receiver identifier returned by discovery candidates or connect.getServerList; never invent an instance address.
ping.options: Optional IRpcPingOptions with local signal and deadline override.
Promise<boolean> for the observed reply; disposal settles an active ping as false. Calling after disposal or without ping capability throws its coded error. Ping cancellation does not require abort middleware.
pingAll: Checks liveness of the statically configured target seeds and retains individual success/failure results.
IRpcFanoutResult<boolean> keyed by the selected actual receivers.
connect: Connection/discovery controls derived from the actual middleware tuple; manual mode exposes query and registration operations.
discovery: Read-only candidate listing and explicit receiver pin controls sharing the canonical discovery owner.
hooks: Local diagnostic subscription facade; hooks.on receives IRpcHookEvent and returns an unsubscriber.
dispose: Idempotently stops admission, drains owned work and releases middleware/adapter resources in the canonical lifecycle order.
Promise resolves after disposal; cleanup failures remain reachable through standard cause/errors traversal, including all failures in the same batch; future operations fail ENDPOINT_DISPOSED.
sendOneWay: Sends an application one-way message and waits for actual physical completion; pair with on at the receiving endpoint.
sendOneWay.targetId: Target base identifier selected by the application in targetIds or returned by endpoint discovery/server-list metadata.
sendOneWay.method: Application method name registered by the receiving endpoint provide or declared in the actual remote contract.
sendOneWay.data: Original application notification payload validated by the installed contract/codec.
sendOneWay.options: Optional IRpcOneWayOptions with explicit local signal/deadline and actual transfer references.
Promise<void> settles on physical send; it never confirms listener execution or a provider business result.
id: Application-assigned stable local endpoint identifier included in outgoing routes.
scheduler: Application monotonic IScheduler shared by endpoint deadlines and PluginHost; now must be finite nonnegative milliseconds.
systemScheduler uses host monotonic time and timers.
Pass the application’s monotonic scheduler when endpoint deadlines must share its clock. Omit it to use the host scheduler.
wallClock: Application IWallClock supplies only wire sentAt and hook timestamps as nonnegative safe-integer epoch milliseconds.
systemWallClock uses the host epoch clock.
Set a wall clock when wire timestamps and diagnostic timestamps must use the application clock. It does not control deadlines.
transport: Actual application adapter selected by top-level config or native connect middleware; native source evidence remains adapter-owned.
Absent: use the selected connect middleware transport; otherwise construction fails.
Supply the exact original carrier side owned by this caller; choose a transport factory for the supported host.
protocol: Canonical semantic IRpcProtocol descriptor selected independently of codec encoding.
rpcProtocolV1 is the default canonical protocol.
Use the protocol descriptor agreed by both ends. Omit it for Core’s default protocol.
codec: ICodec from @migaia/serialize/codec whose encoded output exactly matches the selected framer input.
identityCodecV1 preserves the canonical semantic envelope.
Use a codec whose output matches the framer input. Both ends must agree on the encoded representation.
framer: IRpcFramer from rpc-contract/framing whose actual output is accepted by the selected transport.
messageFramerV1 uses complete unfragmented messages.
Use the framer agreed by both ends; its output must match the transport’s accepted frame.
targetIds: Optional known-peer base identifiers from application deployment configuration; automatic discovery can resolve more later.
Empty seed list; discovery remains available.
provider: Application map of unique method names to IRpcProvider callbacks installed before endpoint construction returns.
Absent: register providers later through provide.
Register startup handlers here when they must exist before ingress starts. Later registrations can use provide on a provider-capable endpoint.
providerLimits: Optional IRpcProviderLimits applied to the existing shared execution/replay admission owner.
Global 256, per-peer 64, replay per-peer 1024.
Bound active provider work when expensive operations need backpressure. The defaults are 256 global and 64 per peer.
idempotency: Optional actual original result store and authenticated scope function for keyed provider work.
Absent: use the endpoint-owned canonical keyed replay policy.
Provide an outcome store on the serving endpoint when retries carry the same idempotency key. A shared store also needs a session scope.
idempotency.store: Optional caller-held IRpcIdempotencyStore shared only across actual intended sessions.
Absent: use the original endpoint-local store.
idempotency.scope: Synchronous application callback receives actual admitted token and senderId, returns a stable scope string; it must not treat arbitrary wire claims as identity.
Absent: canonical admitted-session scope is used.
Derive isolation from an admitted token when sharing an outcome store across sessions.
replay: Outbound active identifiers plus settled tombstone retention, separate from business result storage.
Use maxEntries 4096 and ttlMs 310000.
Size retained outbound identifiers for the request rate and replay window. This ledger is separate from the keyed business-result store.
replay.maxEntries: Maximum retained outbound request identities including active operations and settled tombstones.
`4096` retained outbound identities.
replay.ttlMs: Scheduler milliseconds to retain settled outbound request identity tombstones.
`310000` milliseconds after settlement.
middlewares: Required ordered finite tuple of actual middleware definitions installed atomically by PluginHost.
features: Optional finite immutable tuple of actual native IRpcFeature roots; dependencies remain private and only selected public surfaces are projected.
Empty tuple adds no user-defined features.
Install application features when endpoint-owned cleanup should release them. Omit this tuple when no extra feature is needed.
construction: Caller construction cancellation/deadline; failure still rolls back every installed middleware in original lifecycle order.
Absent: no caller abort or construction deadline.
construction.signal: Optional caller cancellation signal controlling construction and its complete rollback.
Absent: construction has an uncancelled native signal.
construction.timeoutMs: Finite nonnegative construction deadline or false to disable; rollback retains the primary failure and cleanup failures.
Absent or false: no construction deadline.
Disable only the construction deadline.
Use false to rely solely on caller cancellation; use a finite budget when construction must finish within a deadline.

send: Sends one actual carrier value; completion means the physical boundary completed, not that a remote provider executed.
send.message: Original complete message value accepted by this actual carrier domain.
send.options: Optional IRpcSendOptions supplies original physical transfer references.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
ipc.backlog.high: Accepted capacity reached or exceeded ceil(capacity * 0.75), after previously being below its high watermark.

symbols.name: IRpcProbe
symbols.signature: export type IRpcProbe = Readonly<{ /** * Current stage bits on a standalone handle; an attached host data field retains its initial * mask. */ readonly stageMask: number; /** Immutable payload-capture mask compiled at definition. */ readonly captureMask: number; /** Compiled logical method filter; undefined admits all method names. */ readonly methods: ReadonlySet<string> | undefined; /** 0xffffffff means all events; other values compare against the unsigned sample key. */ readonly sampleThreshold: number; /** An empty list pauses the probe; validation failures leave the previous mask unchanged. */ setStages(stages: readonly IRpcProbeStageName[]): void; }>;
symbols.purpose: Frozen genuine compiled handle created by defineProbe; setStages changes private active subscription state without mutating capture permission.
symbols.core:
stageMask: Current compiled subscription mask on standalone handles; attached frozen hosts retain their initial data field. Use readProbeStages for either form.
captureMask: Immutable content-capture permission compiled at definition time.
methods: Captured readonly method filter Set or undefined when unfiltered.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content: Compose actual endpoint or runtime peers while keeping transport and lifecycle ownership with their canonical owners.

declaredConfiguration.name: features
declaredConfiguration.description: Finite immutable tuple of user-defined features installed by the canonical Host batch.

declaredConfiguration.name: transport
declaredConfiguration.type: Omit<IRpcTransport<unknown>, 'send'> & { readonly send: (value: IRpcEnvelope, options?: IRpcSendOptions) => void | Promise<void>; }

declaredConfiguration.name: id
declaredConfiguration.description: Stable local endpoint identity included in every routed protocol envelope.

declaredConfiguration.name: scheduler
declaredConfiguration.description: Endpoint monotonic clock and timers; the same injected instance also drives PluginHost deadlines. `now()` must return finite non-negative milliseconds and is never read as an epoch.

declaredConfiguration.name: wallClock
declaredConfiguration.description: Endpoint wall clock; only produces wire `sentAt` and hook event `at` diagnostics. `timestamp()` must return non-negative safe-integer epoch milliseconds. Defaults to the host wall clock.

declaredConfiguration.name: targetIds
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional known-peer seed; automatic discovery may resolve additional target ids lazily.

declaredConfiguration.name: provider
declaredConfiguration.description: Initial provider methods registered before endpoint construction completes.

declaredConfiguration.name: providerLimits
declaredConfiguration.description: Provider concurrency budgets; defaults to 256 global and 64 per peer.

declaredConfiguration.name: idempotency
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional store and session scope used only for keyed provider requests.

declaredConfiguration.name: idempotency.store
declaredConfiguration.description: Borrowed store for keyed provider executions; omission selects the endpoint-owned default.

declaredConfiguration.name: idempotency.scope
declaredConfiguration.type: (admission: Readonly<{ token: string; senderId: string; }>) => string
declaredConfiguration.description: Compute an authenticated deduplication namespace from admitted token and sender identity.

declaredConfiguration.name: replay
declaredConfiguration.type: { /** Maximum retained outbound request identifiers; defaults to 4096. */ readonly maxEntries?: number; /** Retention time for outbound request identifiers; defaults to 310 seconds. */ readonly ttlMs?: number; }
declaredConfiguration.description: Bounds outbound identifier replay reservations for this endpoint.

declaredConfiguration.name: replay.maxEntries
declaredConfiguration.description: Maximum retained outbound request identifiers; defaults to 4096.

declaredConfiguration.name: replay.ttlMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Retention time for outbound request identifiers; defaults to 310 seconds.

declaredConfiguration.name: middlewares
declaredConfiguration.description: Ordered middleware tuple installed atomically during endpoint construction.

declaredConfiguration.name: construction
declaredConfiguration.type: { /** Aborts construction while still rolling back every installed middleware. */ readonly signal?: IAbortSignal; /** Bounds endpoint construction, or disables the deadline when explicitly `false`. */ readonly timeoutMs?: number | false; }
declaredConfiguration.description: Cancellation and deadline controls for middleware installation and rollback.

declaredConfiguration.name: construction.signal
declaredConfiguration.description: Aborts construction while still rolling back every installed middleware.

declaredConfiguration.name: construction.timeoutMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Bounds endpoint construction, or disables the deadline when explicitly `false`.

Encrypted value or its Promise, passed unchanged into sign.

authentication.decrypt: Inbound sync/async decryption runs on the value recovered by verify. The endpoint then validates the recovered authentication envelope and replay binding.
authentication.decrypt.value: Verified protected value returned by verify.

authentication.sign.value: Encrypted value when encrypt exists, otherwise the replay-bound authentication envelope.

Signed representation or its Promise; throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED. Keep the declared encodedType output domain.

authentication.verify: Inbound sync/async verification receives the protected frame and must recover its authenticated inner value; returning a boolean is not a verification verdict protocol.
authentication.verify.value: Protected value received at the authentication pipeline edge.
authentication.verify.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.

sections.title: 介绍

declaredConfiguration.description: Bidirectional endpoint surface. Select smaller client/provider presets when only one role is needed; dispose retires the endpoint and settles pending work. / export type IRpcEndpoint< TTargetId extends string = string, TMode extends IRpcDiscoveryMode = 'automatic', TPing extends boolean = boolean > = { /** Register one request handler and return this endpoint; a duplicate name throws PROVIDER_DUPLICATED without replacing it. / provide(method: string, provider: IRpcProvider): IRpcEndpoint<TTargetId, TMode, TPing> /** Subscribe to notification events; return the remover for this exact registration. */ on(event: string, listener: IRpcEventListener): () => void /** Request one target result; timeout, cancellation, remote and transport failures reject the Promise. / send<T>(targetId: TTargetId, method: string, data: unknown, options?: ISendOptions): Promise<T> /** Request every configured target and collect each fulfillment or rejection separately. */ sendAll<T>(method: string, data: unknown, options?: ISendOptions): Promise<IRpcFanoutResult<T>> /** Send a notification without a reply Promise; delivery failures are diagnostic. */ dispatch(targetId: TTargetId, method: string, data: unknown): void /** Notify each configured target without collecting remote results. */ dispatchAll(method: string, data: unknown): void /** Submit one atomic request group to an actually admitted native peer. */ group( targetId: TTargetId, steps: IRpcRuntimeGroupSteps, options?: IRpcRuntimeGroupOptions ): Promise<readonly IRpcRuntimeStepOutcome[]> /** Read a logical key's original stored outcome without executing its providers again. */ outcome(targetId: TTargetId, idempotencyKey: string): Promise<IRpcRuntimeOutcomeResult> /** Announce a bounded drain window to one peer without closing the channel in core. */ announceClose( targetId: TTargetId, options: { readonly drainMs: number; readonly receiverId?: string } ): Promise<void> /** Mode-specific connection and receiver-selection controls.

declaredConfiguration.name: report
declaredConfiguration.description: Missing reporters use console.error for every lifecycle and cleanup diagnostic.

declaredConfiguration.name: host
declaredConfiguration.description: Existing Host-control configuration is used only when host is explicitly exposed.

declaredConfiguration.name: catalog
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional Host-control catalog used only when host is explicitly exposed.

declaredConfiguration.name: resolvePlugin
declaredConfiguration.description: Local synchronous resolver for explicitly exposed Host installation controls.

declaredConfiguration.name: endpointFactory
declaredConfiguration.description: A custom runtime assembly receives only the operations held by this channel view.

declaredConfiguration.name: self
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional local identity; omission generates an instance id with the display name peer.

declaredConfiguration.name: providerLimits
declaredConfiguration.description: Provider quotas, defaulting to 256 global and 64 per verified peer.

declaredConfiguration.name: authentication
declaredConfiguration.description: Existing per-frame credentials enable signed native transfer without a custom endpoint.

declaredConfiguration.name: authentication.encrypt
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional outbound encryption; requires matching decrypt plus sign/verify.

declaredConfiguration.name: authentication.decrypt
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional inverse of the configured encryption.

declaredConfiguration.name: authentication.sign
declaredConfiguration.description: Outbound signature/protection transform paired with verify.

declaredConfiguration.name: authentication.verify
declaredConfiguration.description: Inbound verification transform paired with sign.

declaredConfiguration.name: authentication.encodedType
declaredConfiguration.description: Protected representation; any, string or uint8array. Omission uses the middleware's any representation.

declaredConfiguration.name: probe
declaredConfiguration.description: Installs an endpoint-local synchronous observer without changing pipeline selection.

declaredConfiguration.name: defaultTimeoutMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Only request/stream inherit this positive default in their original timeout scope.

declaredConfiguration.name: contract
declaredConfiguration.description: Explicit advanced schema, modes and idempotency retain their original contract owner.

declaredConfiguration.name: keyFactory
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional idempotency key generator; omission uses the canonical identity generator.

declaredConfiguration.name: retryPort
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional whole-invocation retry policy; omission sends once.

symbols.purpose: Creates a Peer facade on the original managed binding and generation holder, retaining restart and native execution ownership.
symbols.core:
options: Peer options plus keyFactory, retryPort and callDeadlineCapMs used by managed proxy dispatch.
binding: Actual IRemoteBinding supplied by the platform owner.
bindEndpoint: Optional canonical callback receiving the actual channel and assembled endpoint, returning the endpoint to retain.
preparation: Original adapter preparation ports and signals; ordinary applications must not forge Host or provider admission provenance.
beforeRelease: Optional async native drain before generation endpoint cleanup; rejection remains observable.
execution: Original supervisor carrying execution authority, supplied only by its real native owner.
Promise of managed IRuntimePeer; close continues channel, owned binding and carrier-listener release even after an earlier cleanup failure. One failure retains identity; multiple failures retain their complete cause/errors graph. Async source wrappers need not return the identical Promise.
endpointFactory: Advanced synchronous invocation of an async endpoint factory with this acquired channel and native abort signal; its Promise must resolve an IRemoteServeEndpoint. Failure triggers construction rollback.
endpointFactory.channel: IRemoteChannelResources acquired by the selected platform source; ownership remains with the original construction.
endpointFactory.signal: Native construction cancellation signal supplied by the peer owner.
Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.
Omitted: the canonical runtime endpoint is assembled from the acquired channel and common options.
Use the managed registration’s original binding and diagnostics; inherited direct-source callbacks do not replace binding.openChannel.
self: Application-supplied safe identity with nonempty name and instanceId; neither credentials nor arbitrary properties are published.
Omitted: the core uses RUNTIME_PEER_DEFAULT_NAME and a generated defaultRpcId; trusted platform bootstrap may supply its own identity.
provide: Application-provided local methods, descriptors or allowed runtime forwarding entries compiled into the accepted directory; methods receive the remote payload and preserve synchronous or async failures.
Omitted: this side publishes no application methods.
providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.
Omitted: the original endpoint or listener admission owner supplies its standard provider limits.
authentication: Original signing, verification and optional encryption configuration installed into canonical endpoint assembly; invalid credentials reject construction before publication.
Omitted: no authentication middleware is added by these options.
Use the application’s paired protection functions on both endpoints. Encryption requires decrypt and the sign/verify pair for replay protection; signing alone needs verify. encodedType must describe the protected frame. Omit authentication only when the carrier’s trust policy permits it.
probe: One IRpcProbe or an array of probes from the application, installed as endpoint-local synchronous observers without selecting a different pipeline.
Omitted: no observer is added by this field.
Attach the application’s message probe when this connection needs diagnostic tracing; omit it for an unobserved connection.
defaultTimeoutMs: Finite positive millisecond default for request and stream calls, validated before acquiring source resources; it does not extend the notify or group timeout scope.
30000 ms for request and stream in the original timeout scope.
contract: Optional IRemoteContract with explicit method schemas, supported modes and idempotency declarations, compiled by the original remote contract owner.
Omitted: provided method definitions supply the normal inferred runtime directory.
report: Synchronous callback receives background or contained failures as error; no return is consumed, and failure handling stays with the original runtime reporter owner.
report.error: Original background or secondary failure supplied by the runtime owner.
No result is used; reporter errors are contained by the reporting boundary.
Omitted: defaultRpcReporter reports to console.error.
keyFactory: Advanced remote-proxy key callback returning an application string for automatically keyed retry paths. The direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read this inherited field itself.
Omitted: proxy paths use defaultRpcId when generating keys; direct peer call keys retain their own call-option semantics.
retryPort: Advanced application-supplied retry dispatch port for remote-proxy paths; it receives the original retry input and returns the selected dispatch result. Direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read it itself.
Omitted: the remote proxy keeps its original retry dispatch owner; no second retry policy is installed by a direct peer.
authentication.encrypt: Outbound sync/async encryption runs after the endpoint wraps its encoded value with replay metadata and before signing. Throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with its cause.
authentication.encrypt.value: Replay-bound authentication envelope produced by the endpoint, including its encoded payload; not the bare application payload.
authentication.encrypt.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Encrypted value or its Promise, passed unchanged into sign.
Leave encrypt and decrypt out together when messages need signatures but not encryption. In that case, sign receives the unencrypted authentication envelope: the message data together with the information used to detect replay. Omitting encryption does not remove signing or verification.
authentication.decrypt: Inbound sync/async decryption runs on the value recovered by verify. The endpoint then validates the recovered authentication envelope and replay binding.
authentication.decrypt.value: Verified protected value returned by verify.
authentication.decrypt.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Recovered replay-bound authentication envelope or its Promise; throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with the original cause.
Omit decrypt only when encrypt is also omitted. After verify checks the signature and recovers the inner value, the endpoint directly checks that value as the authentication envelope, including its replay information. It does not try to decrypt the value.
authentication.sign: Outbound sync/async signing runs after optional encryption and returns the complete protected frame representation. Signing and verification are required even without encryption.
authentication.sign.value: Encrypted value when encrypt exists, otherwise the replay-bound authentication envelope.
authentication.sign.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Signed representation or its Promise; throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED. Keep the declared encodedType output domain.
There is no default signing function. Provide sign together with verify whenever authentication is enabled. This remains required when encrypt and decrypt are configured: encryption alone is insufficient, and omitting sign rejects the configuration.
authentication.verify: Inbound sync/async verification receives the protected frame and must recover its authenticated inner value; returning a boolean is not a verification verdict protocol.
authentication.verify.value: Protected value received at the authentication pipeline edge.
authentication.verify.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Authenticated inner value or its Promise, passed to decrypt when configured; reject or throw on invalid signatures. Local reporting retains the original verification failure, which may be sensitive; the peer receives a sanitized summary. Other returned values still undergo envelope/replay validation.
There is no default verification function. Provide verify together with sign so incoming protected messages can be checked and their inner values recovered. If sign is supplied without verify, construction rejects the configuration before the endpoint becomes active.
authentication.encodedType: Declared protected-output domain must match the next physical pipeline edge. Encrypt/decrypt and sign/verify are complete pairs, at least signing is required, and encryption additionally requires signing.
any: do not impose a declared protected-output value category.
Leave the declared output domain unconstrained; transforms may still change representation.
Declare that the protected output is text for the subsequent pipeline edge.
Declare that the protected output is a byte array for the subsequent pipeline edge.
spawn: The inherited `spawn` callback is unused by this managed factory, which obtains its channel from binding.openChannel.
spawn.context: IRuntimePeerSourceContext from this preparation, containing its self identity and actual offered capabilities; no public abort signal is added to this context.
Promise of a complete IRuntimePeerSourceResult with agreed pipeline and features; failure rejects construction and rolls back resources already acquired.
Omitting or supplying `spawn` leaves channel acquisition with the binding.
Do not set spawn to choose a managed source. This factory uses pricingBinding.openChannel; this inherited callback is not invoked.
connect: The inherited `connect` callback is unused by this managed factory, which obtains its channel from binding.openChannel.
connect.context: IRuntimePeerSourceContext from this preparation, containing its self identity and actual offered capabilities; no public abort signal is added to this context.
Omitting or supplying `connect` leaves channel acquisition with the binding.
Do not set connect to choose a managed source. This factory uses pricingBinding.openChannel; this inherited callback is not invoked.
listen: The inherited `listen` callback is unused by this managed factory, which obtains its channel from binding.openChannel.
listen.context: IRuntimePeerSourceContext from this preparation, containing its self identity and actual offered capabilities; no public abort signal is added to this context.
Omitting or supplying `listen` leaves channel acquisition with the binding.
Do not set listen to choose a managed source. This factory uses pricingBinding.openChannel; this inherited callback is not invoked.
callDeadlineCapMs: Optional positive finite platform ceiling on a logical call deadline, in milliseconds.
Omitted: no additional platform deadline ceiling.

sections.title: 介绍

sections.title: 上手

sections.content: Use a maintained function example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

retryPort: Advanced application-supplied retry dispatch port for remote-proxy paths; it receives the original retry input and returns the selected dispatch result. Direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read it itself.
Omitted: the remote proxy keeps its original retry dispatch owner; no second retry policy is installed by a direct peer.
authentication.encrypt: Outbound sync/async encryption runs after the endpoint wraps its encoded value with replay metadata and before signing. Throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with its cause.
authentication.encrypt.value: Replay-bound authentication envelope produced by the endpoint, including its encoded payload; not the bare application payload.
authentication.encrypt.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Encrypted value or its Promise, passed unchanged into sign.
Leave encrypt and decrypt out together when messages need signatures but not encryption. In that case, sign receives the unencrypted authentication envelope: the message data together with the information used to detect replay. Omitting encryption does not remove signing or verification.
authentication.decrypt: Inbound sync/async decryption runs on the value recovered by verify. The endpoint then validates the recovered authentication envelope and replay binding.
authentication.decrypt.value: Verified protected value returned by verify.
authentication.decrypt.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Recovered replay-bound authentication envelope or its Promise; throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with the original cause.
Omit decrypt only when encrypt is also omitted. After verify checks the signature and recovers the inner value, the endpoint directly checks that value as the authentication envelope, including its replay information. It does not try to decrypt the value.
authentication.sign: Outbound sync/async signing runs after optional encryption and returns the complete protected frame representation. Signing and verification are required even without encryption.
authentication.sign.value: Encrypted value when encrypt exists, otherwise the replay-bound authentication envelope.
authentication.sign.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Signed representation or its Promise; throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED. Keep the declared encodedType output domain.
There is no default signing function. Provide sign together with verify whenever authentication is enabled. This remains required when encrypt and decrypt are configured: encryption alone is insufficient, and omitting sign rejects the configuration.
authentication.verify: Inbound sync/async verification receives the protected frame and must recover its authenticated inner value; returning a boolean is not a verification verdict protocol.
authentication.verify.value: Protected value received at the authentication pipeline edge.
authentication.verify.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Authenticated inner value or its Promise, passed to decrypt when configured; reject or throw on invalid signatures. Local reporting retains the original verification failure, which may be sensitive; the peer receives a sanitized summary. Other returned values still undergo envelope/replay validation.
There is no default verification function. Provide verify together with sign so incoming protected messages can be checked and their inner values recovered. If sign is supplied without verify, construction rejects the configuration before the endpoint becomes active.

any: do not impose a declared protected-output value category.
Leave the declared output domain unconstrained; transforms may still change representation.
Declare that the protected output is text for the subsequent pipeline edge.
Declare that the protected output is a byte array for the subsequent pipeline edge.

symbols.purpose: Creates one accepted direct Peer on exactly one supplied source; failure rolls acquired resources back before rejecting, including entropy failure before endpoint construction.
symbols.core:
options: Application IRuntimePeerOptions selecting one source and provided methods.
resources: Advanced original preparation resources supplied by the canonical adapter owner; ordinary applications omit this argument.
Promise of IRuntimePeer or typed IRuntimeTypedPeer after directory acceptance; caller owns close.
endpointFactory: Advanced synchronous invocation of an async endpoint factory with this acquired channel and native abort signal; its Promise must resolve an IRemoteServeEndpoint. Failure triggers construction rollback.
endpointFactory.channel: IRemoteChannelResources acquired by the selected platform source; ownership remains with the original construction.
endpointFactory.signal: Native construction cancellation signal supplied by the peer owner.
Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.
Omitted: the canonical runtime endpoint is assembled from the acquired channel and common options.
Supply this advanced callback only when the application owns a complete served endpoint; reject construction if that endpoint cannot be acquired.
self: Application-supplied safe identity with nonempty name and instanceId; neither credentials nor arbitrary properties are published.
Omitted: the core uses RUNTIME_PEER_DEFAULT_NAME and a generated defaultRpcId; trusted platform bootstrap may supply its own identity.
provide: Application-provided local methods, descriptors or allowed runtime forwarding entries compiled into the accepted directory; methods receive the remote payload and preserve synchronous or async failures.
Omitted: this side publishes no application methods.
providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.
Omitted: the original endpoint or listener admission owner supplies its standard provider limits.
authentication: Original signing, verification and optional encryption configuration installed into canonical endpoint assembly; invalid credentials reject construction before publication.
Omitted: no authentication middleware is added by these options.
Use the application’s paired protection functions on both endpoints. Encryption requires decrypt and the sign/verify pair for replay protection; signing alone needs verify. encodedType must describe the protected frame. Omit authentication only when the carrier’s trust policy permits it.
probe: One IRpcProbe or an array of probes from the application, installed as endpoint-local synchronous observers without selecting a different pipeline.
Omitted: no observer is added by this field.
defaultTimeoutMs: Finite positive millisecond default for request and stream calls, validated before acquiring source resources; it does not extend the notify or group timeout scope.
30000 ms for request and stream in the original timeout scope.
contract: Optional IRemoteContract with explicit method schemas, supported modes and idempotency declarations, compiled by the original remote contract owner.
Omitted: provided method definitions supply the normal inferred runtime directory.
report: Synchronous callback receives background or contained failures as error; no return is consumed, and failure handling stays with the original runtime reporter owner.
report.error: Original background or secondary failure supplied by the runtime owner.
No result is used; reporter errors are contained by the reporting boundary.
Omitted: defaultRpcReporter reports to console.error.
Keep local diagnostics with this Peer’s owner; keyFactory is inherited but direct requests do not read it.
keyFactory: Advanced remote-proxy key callback returning an application string for automatically keyed retry paths. The direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read this inherited field itself.
Omitted: proxy paths use defaultRpcId when generating keys; direct peer call keys retain their own call-option semantics.
Direct Peer requests do not consult this inherited policy. Use a managed or remote proxy dispatch path when logical-key or retry policy is required.
retryPort: Advanced application-supplied retry dispatch port for remote-proxy paths; it receives the original retry input and returns the selected dispatch result. Direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read it itself.
Omitted: the remote proxy keeps its original retry dispatch owner; no second retry policy is installed by a direct peer.
authentication.encrypt: Outbound sync/async encryption runs after the endpoint wraps its encoded value with replay metadata and before signing. Throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with its cause.
authentication.encrypt.value: Replay-bound authentication envelope produced by the endpoint, including its encoded payload; not the bare application payload.
authentication.encrypt.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Encrypted value or its Promise, passed unchanged into sign.
Leave encrypt and decrypt out together when messages need signatures but not encryption. In that case, sign receives the unencrypted authentication envelope: the message data together with the information used to detect replay. Omitting encryption does not remove signing or verification.
authentication.decrypt: Inbound sync/async decryption runs on the value recovered by verify. The endpoint then validates the recovered authentication envelope and replay binding.
authentication.decrypt.value: Verified protected value returned by verify.
authentication.decrypt.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Recovered replay-bound authentication envelope or its Promise; throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with the original cause.
Omit decrypt only when encrypt is also omitted. After verify checks the signature and recovers the inner value, the endpoint directly checks that value as the authentication envelope, including its replay information. It does not try to decrypt the value.
authentication.sign: Outbound sync/async signing runs after optional encryption and returns the complete protected frame representation. Signing and verification are required even without encryption.
authentication.sign.value: Encrypted value when encrypt exists, otherwise the replay-bound authentication envelope.
authentication.sign.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Signed representation or its Promise; throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED. Keep the declared encodedType output domain.
There is no default signing function. Provide sign together with verify whenever authentication is enabled. This remains required when encrypt and decrypt are configured: encryption alone is insufficient, and omitting sign rejects the configuration.
authentication.verify: Inbound sync/async verification receives the protected frame and must recover its authenticated inner value; returning a boolean is not a verification verdict protocol.
authentication.verify.value: Protected value received at the authentication pipeline edge.
authentication.verify.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Authenticated inner value or its Promise, passed to decrypt when configured; reject or throw on invalid signatures. Local reporting retains the original verification failure, which may be sensitive; the peer receives a sanitized summary. Other returned values still undergo envelope/replay validation.
There is no default verification function. Provide verify together with sign so incoming protected messages can be checked and their inner values recovered. If sign is supplied without verify, construction rejects the configuration before the endpoint becomes active.
authentication.encodedType: Declared protected-output domain must match the next physical pipeline edge. Encrypt/decrypt and sign/verify are complete pairs, at least signing is required, and encryption additionally requires signing.
any: do not impose a declared protected-output value category.
Leave the declared output domain unconstrained; transforms may still change representation.
Declare that the protected output is text for the subsequent pipeline edge.
Declare that the protected output is a byte array for the subsequent pipeline edge.
spawn: Application source callback receiving the safe local identity and capability offer; choose exactly one source.
spawn.context: IRuntimePeerSourceContext from this preparation, containing its self identity and actual offered capabilities; no public abort signal is added to this context.
Promise of a complete IRuntimePeerSourceResult with agreed pipeline and features; failure rejects construction and rolls back resources already acquired.
Omitting spawn means this Peer starts no execution unit through that source. Select connect to reach an existing peer, or listen to accept one; exactly one source is required.
The application source supplies a real negotiated channel; direct Peer calls use their existing dispatcher and do not consult retryPort.
connect: Application source callback opening a channel to an existing peer; choose exactly one source.
connect.context: IRuntimePeerSourceContext from this preparation, containing its self identity and actual offered capabilities; no public abort signal is added to this context.
Omitting connect means no outgoing connection is opened through this source. Choose spawn to start a peer or listen to accept one instead; exactly one source is required.
listen: Application source callback accepting a negotiated peer channel; choose exactly one source.
listen.context: IRuntimePeerSourceContext from this preparation, containing its self identity and actual offered capabilities; no public abort signal is added to this context.
Omitting listen means this Peer does not accept incoming connections through this source. Choose spawn or connect for the initiating side; exactly one source is required.

declaredConfiguration.description: Optional local identity; omission generates an instance id with the display name peer.

declaredConfiguration.description: Explicit nested own-data method groups; defaults to no application methods and rejects accessors during compilation.

declaredConfiguration.description: Owned source opener; exactly one of spawn, connect or listen is required.

declaredConfiguration.description: Connected source opener; exactly one source is required.

declaredConfiguration.description: Listener source opener; exactly one source is required.

declaredConfiguration.description: Provider quotas, defaulting to 256 global and 64 per verified peer.

declaredConfiguration.name: authentication
declaredConfiguration.description: Existing per-frame credentials enable signed native transfer without a custom endpoint.

declaredConfiguration.description: Optional outbound encryption; requires matching decrypt plus sign/verify.

declaredConfiguration.description: Optional inverse of the configured encryption.

declaredConfiguration.description: Outbound signature/protection transform paired with verify.

declaredConfiguration.description: Inbound verification transform paired with sign.

declaredConfiguration.description: Protected representation; any, string or uint8array. Omission uses the middleware's any representation.

declaredConfiguration.description: Installs an endpoint-local synchronous observer without changing pipeline selection.

declaredConfiguration.description: Only request/stream inherit this positive default in their original timeout scope.

declaredConfiguration.description: Explicit advanced schema, modes and idempotency retain their original contract owner.

declaredConfiguration.description: Optional idempotency key generator; omission uses the canonical identity generator.

declaredConfiguration.description: Optional whole-invocation retry policy; omission sends once.

endpointFactory: Advanced synchronous invocation of an async endpoint factory with this acquired channel and native abort signal; its Promise must resolve an IRemoteServeEndpoint. Failure triggers construction rollback.

Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.
Omitted: the canonical runtime endpoint is assembled from the acquired channel and common options.
self: Application-supplied safe identity with nonempty name and instanceId; neither credentials nor arbitrary properties are published.
Omitted: the core uses RUNTIME_PEER_DEFAULT_NAME and a generated defaultRpcId; trusted platform bootstrap may supply its own identity.
providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.

authentication: Original signing, verification and optional encryption configuration installed into canonical endpoint assembly; invalid credentials reject construction before publication.
Omitted: no authentication middleware is added by these options.
probe: One IRpcProbe or an array of probes from the application, installed as endpoint-local synchronous observers without selecting a different pipeline.
Omitted: no observer is added by this field.
defaultTimeoutMs: Finite positive millisecond default for request and stream calls, validated before acquiring source resources; it does not extend the notify or group timeout scope.

contract: Optional IRemoteContract with explicit method schemas, supported modes and idempotency declarations, compiled by the original remote contract owner.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
methods: Method paths callable on the other side, from its accepted directory.
counters: Call counters: `inFlight` (calls not yet finished) is measured; `sent`, `received`, `errors`, `lastActiveAt` are reported unavailable; or `{ status: "unavailable", reason }` when the owner cannot observe it.
recent: Recent lifecycle records (`IRuntimeRecent`), newest last.
identity: Identity `{ name, instanceId }` the other side announced, or `{ status: "unavailable", reason }` when the owner cannot observe it.
generation: Generation accepted from the other side (not the local restart count).
kind: How the connection was configured: `spawn`, `connect` or `listen`.
direction: Who started it: `spawned`, `spawned-by` (this side is the child), `connect` or `listen`.
carrier: Name of the physical carrier, such as a MessagePort or stdio.
connection: `{ status }`: `ready`, `closed`, `departed`, or unavailable.
unit: Supervised unit `{ kind, state, generation, degraded }`, or `{ status: "unavailable", reason }` when the owner cannot observe it.
health: Health check metric `{ state, failures }`, or `{ status: "unavailable", reason }` when the owner cannot observe it.
restartCount: Number of restarts as a metric, or `{ status: "unavailable", reason }` when the owner cannot observe it.
resources: Sampled resources (pid or threadId, memory, CPU time, event-loop utilisation), or `{ status: "unavailable", reason }` when the owner cannot observe it.
lastExit: Last exit `{ generation, reason, code, signal, error? }`, or `{ status: "unavailable", reason }` when the owner cannot observe it.

symbols.core:
endpointFactory: Advanced synchronous invocation of an async endpoint factory with this acquired channel and native abort signal; its Promise must resolve an IRemoteServeEndpoint. Failure triggers construction rollback.
endpointFactory.channel: IRemoteChannelResources acquired by the selected platform source; ownership remains with the original construction.
endpointFactory.signal: Native construction cancellation signal supplied by the peer owner.
Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.
Omitted: the canonical runtime endpoint is assembled from the acquired channel and common options.
Supply this advanced callback only when the application owns a complete served endpoint; reject construction if that endpoint cannot be acquired.
self: Application-supplied safe identity with nonempty name and instanceId; neither credentials nor arbitrary properties are published.
Omitted: the core uses RUNTIME_PEER_DEFAULT_NAME and a generated defaultRpcId; trusted platform bootstrap may supply its own identity.
provide: Application-provided local methods, descriptors or allowed runtime forwarding entries compiled into the accepted directory; methods receive the remote payload and preserve synchronous or async failures.
Omitted: this side publishes no application methods.
providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.
Omitted: the original endpoint or listener admission owner supplies its standard provider limits.
authentication: Original signing, verification and optional encryption configuration installed into canonical endpoint assembly; invalid credentials reject construction before publication.
Omitted: no authentication middleware is added by these options.
Use the application’s paired protection functions on both endpoints. Encryption requires decrypt and the sign/verify pair for replay protection; signing alone needs verify. encodedType must describe the protected frame. Omit authentication only when the carrier’s trust policy permits it.
probe: One IRpcProbe or an array of probes from the application, installed as endpoint-local synchronous observers without selecting a different pipeline.
Omitted: no observer is added by this field.
defaultTimeoutMs: Finite positive millisecond default for request and stream calls, validated before acquiring source resources; it does not extend the notify or group timeout scope.
30000 ms for request and stream in the original timeout scope.
contract: Optional IRemoteContract with explicit method schemas, supported modes and idempotency declarations, compiled by the original remote contract owner.
Omitted: provided method definitions supply the normal inferred runtime directory.
report: Synchronous callback receives background or contained failures as error; no return is consumed, and failure handling stays with the original runtime reporter owner.
report.error: Original background or secondary failure supplied by the runtime owner.
No result is used; reporter errors are contained by the reporting boundary.
Omitted: defaultRpcReporter reports to console.error.
Keep local diagnostics with this Peer’s owner; keyFactory is inherited but direct requests do not read it.
keyFactory: Advanced remote-proxy key callback returning an application string for automatically keyed retry paths. The direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read this inherited field itself.
Omitted: proxy paths use defaultRpcId when generating keys; direct peer call keys retain their own call-option semantics.
Direct Peer requests do not consult this inherited policy. Use a managed or remote proxy dispatch path when logical-key or retry policy is required.
retryPort: Advanced application-supplied retry dispatch port for remote-proxy paths; it receives the original retry input and returns the selected dispatch result. Direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read it itself.
Omitted: the remote proxy keeps its original retry dispatch owner; no second retry policy is installed by a direct peer.
authentication.encrypt: Outbound sync/async encryption runs after the endpoint wraps its encoded value with replay metadata and before signing. Throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with its cause.
authentication.encrypt.value: Replay-bound authentication envelope produced by the endpoint, including its encoded payload; not the bare application payload.
authentication.encrypt.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Encrypted value or its Promise, passed unchanged into sign.
Leave encrypt and decrypt out together when messages need signatures but not encryption. In that case, sign receives the unencrypted authentication envelope: the message data together with the information used to detect replay. Omitting encryption does not remove signing or verification.
authentication.decrypt: Inbound sync/async decryption runs on the value recovered by verify. The endpoint then validates the recovered authentication envelope and replay binding.
authentication.decrypt.value: Verified protected value returned by verify.
authentication.decrypt.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Recovered replay-bound authentication envelope or its Promise; throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with the original cause.
Omit decrypt only when encrypt is also omitted. After verify checks the signature and recovers the inner value, the endpoint directly checks that value as the authentication envelope, including its replay information. It does not try to decrypt the value.
authentication.sign: Outbound sync/async signing runs after optional encryption and returns the complete protected frame representation. Signing and verification are required even without encryption.
authentication.sign.value: Encrypted value when encrypt exists, otherwise the replay-bound authentication envelope.
authentication.sign.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Signed representation or its Promise; throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED. Keep the declared encodedType output domain.
There is no default signing function. Provide sign together with verify whenever authentication is enabled. This remains required when encrypt and decrypt are configured: encryption alone is insufficient, and omitting sign rejects the configuration.
authentication.verify: Inbound sync/async verification receives the protected frame and must recover its authenticated inner value; returning a boolean is not a verification verdict protocol.
authentication.verify.value: Protected value received at the authentication pipeline edge.
authentication.verify.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Authenticated inner value or its Promise, passed to decrypt when configured; reject or throw on invalid signatures. Local reporting retains the original verification failure, which may be sensitive; the peer receives a sanitized summary. Other returned values still undergo envelope/replay validation.

authentication.encodedType: Declared protected-output domain must match the next physical pipeline edge. Encrypt/decrypt and sign/verify are complete pairs, at least signing is required, and encryption additionally requires signing.
any: do not impose a declared protected-output value category.
Leave the declared output domain unconstrained; transforms may still change representation.
Declare that the protected output is text for the subsequent pipeline edge.
Declare that the protected output is a byte array for the subsequent pipeline edge.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
endpointFactory: Advanced synchronous invocation of an async endpoint factory with this acquired channel and native abort signal; its Promise must resolve an IRemoteServeEndpoint. Failure triggers construction rollback.
endpointFactory.channel: IRemoteChannelResources acquired by the selected platform source; ownership remains with the original construction.
endpointFactory.signal: Native construction cancellation signal supplied by the peer owner.
Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.
Omitted: the canonical runtime endpoint is assembled from the acquired channel and common options.
Supply this advanced callback only when the application owns a complete served endpoint; reject construction if that endpoint cannot be acquired.
self: Application-supplied safe identity with nonempty name and instanceId; neither credentials nor arbitrary properties are published.
Omitted: the core uses RUNTIME_PEER_DEFAULT_NAME and a generated defaultRpcId; trusted platform bootstrap may supply its own identity.
provide: Application-provided local methods, descriptors or allowed runtime forwarding entries compiled into the accepted directory; methods receive the remote payload and preserve synchronous or async failures.
Omitted: this side publishes no application methods.
providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.
Omitted: the original endpoint or listener admission owner supplies its standard provider limits.
authentication: Original signing, verification and optional encryption configuration installed into canonical endpoint assembly; invalid credentials reject construction before publication.
Omitted: no authentication middleware is added by these options.
Use the application’s paired protection functions on both endpoints. Encryption requires decrypt and the sign/verify pair for replay protection; signing alone needs verify. encodedType must describe the protected frame. Omit authentication only when the carrier’s trust policy permits it.
probe: One IRpcProbe or an array of probes from the application, installed as endpoint-local synchronous observers without selecting a different pipeline.
Omitted: no observer is added by this field.
defaultTimeoutMs: Finite positive millisecond default for request and stream calls, validated before acquiring source resources; it does not extend the notify or group timeout scope.
30000 ms for request and stream in the original timeout scope.
contract: Optional IRemoteContract with explicit method schemas, supported modes and idempotency declarations, compiled by the original remote contract owner.
Omitted: provided method definitions supply the normal inferred runtime directory.
report: Synchronous callback receives background or contained failures as error; no return is consumed, and failure handling stays with the original runtime reporter owner.
report.error: Original background or secondary failure supplied by the runtime owner.
No result is used; reporter errors are contained by the reporting boundary.
Omitted: defaultRpcReporter reports to console.error.
Keep local diagnostics with this Peer’s owner; keyFactory is inherited but direct requests do not read it.
keyFactory: Advanced remote-proxy key callback returning an application string for automatically keyed retry paths. The direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read this inherited field itself.
Omitted: proxy paths use defaultRpcId when generating keys; direct peer call keys retain their own call-option semantics.
Direct Peer requests do not consult this inherited policy. Use a managed or remote proxy dispatch path when logical-key or retry policy is required.
retryPort: Advanced application-supplied retry dispatch port for remote-proxy paths; it receives the original retry input and returns the selected dispatch result. Direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read it itself.
Omitted: the remote proxy keeps its original retry dispatch owner; no second retry policy is installed by a direct peer.
authentication.encrypt: Outbound sync/async encryption runs after the endpoint wraps its encoded value with replay metadata and before signing. Throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with its cause.
authentication.encrypt.value: Replay-bound authentication envelope produced by the endpoint, including its encoded payload; not the bare application payload.
authentication.encrypt.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Encrypted value or its Promise, passed unchanged into sign.
Leave encrypt and decrypt out together when messages need signatures but not encryption. In that case, sign receives the unencrypted authentication envelope: the message data together with the information used to detect replay. Omitting encryption does not remove signing or verification.
authentication.decrypt: Inbound sync/async decryption runs on the value recovered by verify. The endpoint then validates the recovered authentication envelope and replay binding.
authentication.decrypt.value: Verified protected value returned by verify.
authentication.decrypt.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Recovered replay-bound authentication envelope or its Promise; throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with the original cause.
Omit decrypt only when encrypt is also omitted. After verify checks the signature and recovers the inner value, the endpoint directly checks that value as the authentication envelope, including its replay information. It does not try to decrypt the value.
authentication.sign: Outbound sync/async signing runs after optional encryption and returns the complete protected frame representation. Signing and verification are required even without encryption.
authentication.sign.value: Encrypted value when encrypt exists, otherwise the replay-bound authentication envelope.
authentication.sign.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Signed representation or its Promise; throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED. Keep the declared encodedType output domain.
There is no default signing function. Provide sign together with verify whenever authentication is enabled. This remains required when encrypt and decrypt are configured: encryption alone is insufficient, and omitting sign rejects the configuration.
authentication.verify: Inbound sync/async verification receives the protected frame and must recover its authenticated inner value; returning a boolean is not a verification verdict protocol.
authentication.verify.value: Protected value received at the authentication pipeline edge.
authentication.verify.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Authenticated inner value or its Promise, passed to decrypt when configured; reject or throw on invalid signatures. Local reporting retains the original verification failure, which may be sensitive; the peer receives a sanitized summary. Other returned values still undergo envelope/replay validation.
There is no default verification function. Provide verify together with sign so incoming protected messages can be checked and their inner values recovered. If sign is supplied without verify, construction rejects the configuration before the endpoint becomes active.
authentication.encodedType: Declared protected-output domain must match the next physical pipeline edge. Encrypt/decrypt and sign/verify are complete pairs, at least signing is required, and encryption additionally requires signing.
any: do not impose a declared protected-output value category.
Leave the declared output domain unconstrained; transforms may still change representation.
Declare that the protected output is text for the subsequent pipeline edge.
Declare that the protected output is a byte array for the subsequent pipeline edge.
spawn: Application source callback receiving the safe local identity and capability offer; choose exactly one source.
spawn.context: IRuntimePeerSourceContext from this preparation, containing its self identity and actual offered capabilities; no public abort signal is added to this context.
Promise of a complete IRuntimePeerSourceResult with agreed pipeline and features; failure rejects construction and rolls back resources already acquired.
Omitting spawn means this Peer starts no execution unit through that source. Select connect to reach an existing peer, or listen to accept one; exactly one source is required.
The application source supplies a real negotiated channel; direct Peer calls use their existing dispatcher and do not consult retryPort.
connect: Application source callback opening a channel to an existing peer; choose exactly one source.
connect.context: IRuntimePeerSourceContext from this preparation, containing its self identity and actual offered capabilities; no public abort signal is added to this context.
Omitting connect means no outgoing connection is opened through this source. Choose spawn to start a peer or listen to accept one instead; exactly one source is required.
listen: Application source callback accepting a negotiated peer channel; choose exactly one source.
listen.context: IRuntimePeerSourceContext from this preparation, containing its self identity and actual offered capabilities; no public abort signal is added to this context.
Omitting listen means this Peer does not accept incoming connections through this source. Choose spawn or connect for the initiating side; exactly one source is required.
