sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
endpointFactory: Advanced synchronous invocation of an async endpoint factory with this acquired channel and native abort signal; its Promise must resolve an IRemoteServeEndpoint. Failure triggers construction rollback.
endpointFactory.channel: IRemoteChannelResources acquired by the selected platform source; ownership remains with the original construction.
endpointFactory.signal: Native construction cancellation signal supplied by the peer owner.
Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.
Omitted: the canonical runtime endpoint is assembled from the acquired channel and common options.
Reuse actual Host integration and original channel resources; local callbacks retain acquisition, resolution and diagnostic ownership.
self: Application-supplied safe identity with nonempty name and instanceId; neither credentials nor arbitrary properties are published.
Omitted: the core uses RUNTIME_PEER_DEFAULT_NAME and a generated defaultRpcId; trusted platform bootstrap may supply its own identity.
provide: Application-provided local methods, descriptors or allowed runtime forwarding entries compiled into the accepted directory; methods receive the remote payload and preserve synchronous or async failures.
Omitted: this side publishes no application methods.
providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.
Omitted: the original endpoint or listener admission owner supplies its standard provider limits.
authentication: Original signing, verification and optional encryption configuration installed into canonical endpoint assembly; invalid credentials reject construction before publication.
Omitted: no authentication middleware is added by these options.
Use the application’s paired protection functions on both endpoints. Encryption requires decrypt and the sign/verify pair for replay protection; signing alone needs verify. encodedType must describe the protected frame. Omit authentication only when the carrier’s trust policy permits it.
probe: One IRpcProbe or an array of probes from the application, installed as endpoint-local synchronous observers without selecting a different pipeline.
Omitted: no observer is added by this field.
Attach the application’s message probe when this connection needs diagnostic tracing; omit it for an unobserved connection.
defaultTimeoutMs: Finite positive millisecond default for request and stream calls, validated before acquiring source resources; it does not extend the notify or group timeout scope.
30000 ms for request and stream in the original timeout scope.
contract: Optional IRemoteContract with explicit method schemas, supported modes and idempotency declarations, compiled by the original remote contract owner.
Omitted: provided method definitions supply the normal inferred runtime directory.
report: Synchronous callback receives background or contained failures as error; no return is consumed, and failure handling stays with the original runtime reporter owner.
report.error: Original background or secondary failure supplied by the runtime owner.
No result is used; reporter errors are contained by the reporting boundary.
Omitted: defaultRpcReporter reports to console.error.
keyFactory: Advanced remote-proxy key callback returning an application string for automatically keyed retry paths. The direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read this inherited field itself.
Omitted: proxy paths use defaultRpcId when generating keys; direct peer call keys retain their own call-option semantics.
Supply local logical-key or retry policy only for the actual installed dispatch path; direct borrowed Peer dispatch may leave them unused.
retryPort: Advanced application-supplied retry dispatch port for remote-proxy paths; it receives the original retry input and returns the selected dispatch result. Direct createRuntimePeer assembly does not read it itself.
Omitted: the remote proxy keeps its original retry dispatch owner; no second retry policy is installed by a direct peer.
authentication.encrypt: Outbound sync/async encryption runs after the endpoint wraps its encoded value with replay metadata and before signing. Throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with its cause.
authentication.encrypt.value: Replay-bound authentication envelope produced by the endpoint, including its encoded payload; not the bare application payload.
authentication.encrypt.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Encrypted value or its Promise, passed unchanged into sign.
Leave encrypt and decrypt out together when messages need signatures but not encryption. In that case, sign receives the unencrypted authentication envelope: the message data together with the information used to detect replay. Omitting encryption does not remove signing or verification.
authentication.decrypt: Inbound sync/async decryption runs on the value recovered by verify. The endpoint then validates the recovered authentication envelope and replay binding.
authentication.decrypt.value: Verified protected value returned by verify.
authentication.decrypt.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Recovered replay-bound authentication envelope or its Promise; throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with the original cause.
Omit decrypt only when encrypt is also omitted. After verify checks the signature and recovers the inner value, the endpoint directly checks that value as the authentication envelope, including its replay information. It does not try to decrypt the value.
authentication.sign: Outbound sync/async signing runs after optional encryption and returns the complete protected frame representation. Signing and verification are required even without encryption.
authentication.sign.value: Encrypted value when encrypt exists, otherwise the replay-bound authentication envelope.
authentication.sign.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Signed representation or its Promise; throw/rejection normally becomes AUTHENTICATION_FAILED. Keep the declared encodedType output domain.
There is no default signing function. Provide sign together with verify whenever authentication is enabled. This remains required when encrypt and decrypt are configured: encryption alone is insufficient, and omitting sign rejects the configuration.
authentication.verify: Inbound sync/async verification receives the protected frame and must recover its authenticated inner value; returning a boolean is not a verification verdict protocol.
authentication.verify.value: Protected value received at the authentication pipeline edge.
authentication.verify.context: IRpcAuthenticationContext issued by the endpoint: direction is outbound/inbound, endpointId is its local identifier and platform is its configured IRpcPlatformValue.
Authenticated inner value or its Promise, passed to decrypt when configured; reject or throw on invalid signatures. Local reporting retains the original verification failure, which may be sensitive; the peer receives a sanitized summary. Other returned values still undergo envelope/replay validation.
There is no default verification function. Provide verify together with sign so incoming protected messages can be checked and their inner values recovered. If sign is supplied without verify, construction rejects the configuration before the endpoint becomes active.
authentication.encodedType: Declared protected-output domain must match the next physical pipeline edge. Encrypt/decrypt and sign/verify are complete pairs, at least signing is required, and encryption additionally requires signing.
any: do not impose a declared protected-output value category.
Leave the declared output domain unconstrained; transforms may still change representation.
Declare that the protected output is text for the subsequent pipeline edge.
Declare that the protected output is a byte array for the subsequent pipeline edge.
spawn: Application source callback receiving the safe local identity and capability offer; choose exactly one source.
spawn.context: IRuntimePeerSourceContext from this preparation, containing its self identity and actual offered capabilities; no public abort signal is added to this context.
Promise of a complete IRuntimePeerSourceResult with agreed pipeline and features; failure rejects construction and rolls back resources already acquired.
Omitting spawn means this Peer starts no execution unit through that source. Select connect to reach an existing peer, or listen to accept one; exactly one source is required.
Choose exactly one source input interpreted by the actual platform peer factory; preserve that factory’s acquisition semantics.
connect: Application source callback opening a channel to an existing peer; choose exactly one source.
connect.context: IRuntimePeerSourceContext from this preparation, containing its self identity and actual offered capabilities; no public abort signal is added to this context.
Omitting connect means no outgoing connection is opened through this source. Choose spawn to start a peer or listen to accept one instead; exactly one source is required.
listen: Application source callback accepting a negotiated peer channel; choose exactly one source.
listen.context: IRuntimePeerSourceContext from this preparation, containing its self identity and actual offered capabilities; no public abort signal is added to this context.
Omitting listen means this Peer does not accept incoming connections through this source. Choose spawn or connect for the initiating side; exactly one source is required.
name: Caller-selected nonempty registration name copied when constructing the cold plugin; use the same name when addressing the installed runtime outlet.
expose: Distinct nonempty paths explicitly exposing current Host feature methods, runtime connection routes or the reserved host control entry. Only this snapshotted whitelist becomes remotely callable.
Omitted: an empty whitelist; only provide methods are published.
host: The same actual PluginHost handle into which this plugin is installed, supplying use, unUse, plugin and revision for explicit host exposure.
Omitted: allowed unless expose contains host; explicit host exposure requires host, catalog and resolvePlugin together.
catalog: Application-authored IRemoteHostCatalog declaring the only plugin contracts available through explicitly exposed host control.
Omitted: no host-control catalog; required when expose contains host.
resolvePlugin: Synchronous local resolver invoked by the canonical host-control owner after catalog admission; definitions remain local and are installed through the original Host.
resolvePlugin.name: Plugin name admitted by the declared catalog.
resolvePlugin.config: Optional portable configuration from the remote host-use request.
Local plugin definition accepted by the Host; a thrown error rejects the host-use request.
Omitted: no local resolver; required when expose contains host.

symbols.signature: export type IRuntimeTypedPeer<TRemote = Record<never, never>, S = IRuntimeFlatten<TRemote>, K = (typeof import('./constants.js').RuntimePluginKey)['thread']> = Pick<IRuntimePeerHandle, 'self' | 'describe' | 'close' | 'outcome' | 'on' | typeof Symbol.asyncDispose> & Readonly<{ /** Group scalar methods from this exact declared remote surface. */ group<Steps extends readonly IRuntimeGroupStep<S>[]>(steps: Steps, options?: IRuntimeFamilyGroupOptions<K>): Promise<readonly IRpcRuntimeStepOutcome[]>; /** Request one declared scalar method with its inferred payload/result types. */ request<M extends Extract<IRuntimeScalarKeys<S>, string>>(method: M, ...args: [...IRuntimePayload<S[M]>, options?: IRuntimeFamilyCallOptions<K>]): Promise<IRuntimeResult<S[M]>>; /** * Notify a declared scalar method; successful sending is not a remote completion * acknowledgement. */ notify<M extends Extract<IRuntimeScalarKeys<S>, string>>(method: M, ...args: [...IRuntimePayload<S[M]>, options?: IRuntimeFamilyCallOptions<K>]): Promise<void>; /** Iterate one declared generator method; yielded values keep the original inferred type. */ stream<M extends Extract<IRuntimeStreamKeys<S>, string>>(method: M, ...args: [...IRuntimePayload<S[M]>, options?: IRuntimeFamilyCallOptions<K>]): AsyncIterableIterator<IRuntimeYield<S[M]>>; }>;
symbols.purpose: A Runtime Peer typed by `TRemote`: method names, payloads and results are checked against the other side API. Also has `self`, `describe()`, `outcome()`, `on()` and `close()`.
symbols.core:
self: Frozen local peer name and instanceId minted or supplied during this connection construction; it is not a remote authentication principal.
outcome: Queries the original remote operation ledger for a prior idempotency key, without dispatching that operation again.
outcome.idempotencyKey: The caller-issued key supplied as options.idempotencyKey on an earlier request to this connection.
Promise of IRpcRuntimeOutcomeResult; support and availability come from the accepted remote runtime contract.
describe: Queries the local accepted peer detail asynchronously. Without format returns IRuntimeDetail; json, yaml or toml returns the admitted text projection. It does not claim unavailable physical metrics.
describe.options: Optional query format from IRuntimeQueryOptions; omitted returns the object snapshot.
Promise of local detail or formatted text, following the selected query format.
on: Registers a future RuntimeEventName listener after construction; factory resolution already represents initial readiness. Listener return is ignored and failures are contained by the runtime reporter.
on.event: A RuntimeEventName value such as ready or exit; it selects future connection lifecycle notifications.
on.listener: Callback receives IRuntimeEvent from this connection; return is ignored and throws or rejected thenables are reported.
Idempotent removal function for this registration; closing the peer clears its publisher.
close: Ends this logical connection and releases its owned channel resources; platform factories also terminate a worker or child they spawned.
Shared completion Promise retaining the original close operation identity; no new calls are admitted once closing begins.
[Symbol.asyncDispose]: Scoped asynchronous cleanup is the exact original close operation, including its Promise identity.
The same completion Promise as close(), including platform-owned resource cleanup.
request: Calls a method the other side provides and waits for its result. Default deadline 30000 ms (`defaultTimeoutMs`); errors keep their native type and `(source, code)`.
request.method: Dotted path of a method in the other side `provide`, e.g. `math.double`.
request.args: `(payload?, options?)`: one payload and call options (`timeoutMs`, `signal`, `transfer`, `idempotencyKey`).
The method result, typed from `TRemote`.
notify: Sends a one-way call; no result comes back.
notify.method: Dotted method path provided by the other side.
notify.args: `(payload?, options?)` as for `request`.
Resolves once the call was sent.
stream: Calls a method that returns an iterable and yields its items as they arrive.
stream.method: Dotted path of an iterator method provided by the other side.
stream.args: `(payload?, options?)` as for `request`.
An async iterator of the yielded items.
group: Sends several calls as one batch and returns the outcome of each step in order.
group.steps: Steps `{ method, payload? }` in order.
group.options: Batch options such as `timeoutMs` and `signal`.
One outcome per step (success value or error).

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: A Runtime Peer typed by `TRemote`: method names, payloads and results are checked against the other side API. Also has `self`, `describe()`, `outcome()`, `on()` and `close()`.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import IRuntimeTypedPeer from @migaia/rpc-core/remote, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use IRuntimeTypedPeer when its type contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when IRuntimeTypedPeer does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained type example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
self: Frozen local peer name and instanceId minted or supplied during this connection construction; it is not a remote authentication principal.
outcome: Queries the original remote operation ledger for a prior idempotency key, without dispatching that operation again.
outcome.idempotencyKey: The caller-issued key supplied as options.idempotencyKey on an earlier request to this connection.
Promise of IRpcRuntimeOutcomeResult; support and availability come from the accepted remote runtime contract.
describe: Queries the local accepted peer detail asynchronously. Without format returns IRuntimeDetail; json, yaml or toml returns the admitted text projection. It does not claim unavailable physical metrics.
describe.options: Optional query format from IRuntimeQueryOptions; omitted returns the object snapshot.
Promise of local detail or formatted text, following the selected query format.
on: Registers a future RuntimeEventName listener after construction; factory resolution already represents initial readiness. Listener return is ignored and failures are contained by the runtime reporter.
on.event: A RuntimeEventName value such as ready or exit; it selects future connection lifecycle notifications.
on.listener: Callback receives IRuntimeEvent from this connection; return is ignored and throws or rejected thenables are reported.
Idempotent removal function for this registration; closing the peer clears its publisher.
close: Ends this logical connection and releases its owned channel resources; platform factories also terminate a worker or child they spawned.
Shared completion Promise retaining the original close operation identity; no new calls are admitted once closing begins.
[Symbol.asyncDispose]: Scoped asynchronous cleanup is the exact original close operation, including its Promise identity.
The same completion Promise as close(), including platform-owned resource cleanup.
request: Calls a method the other side provides and waits for its result. Default deadline 30000 ms (`defaultTimeoutMs`); errors keep their native type and `(source, code)`.
request.method: Dotted path of a method in the other side `provide`, e.g. `math.double`.
request.args: `(payload?, options?)`: one payload and call options (`timeoutMs`, `signal`, `transfer`, `idempotencyKey`).
The method result, typed from `TRemote`.
notify: Sends a one-way call; no result comes back.
notify.method: Dotted method path provided by the other side.
notify.args: `(payload?, options?)` as for `request`.
Resolves once the call was sent.
stream: Calls a method that returns an iterable and yields its items as they arrive.
stream.method: Dotted path of an iterator method provided by the other side.
stream.args: `(payload?, options?)` as for `request`.
An async iterator of the yielded items.
group: Sends several calls as one batch and returns the outcome of each step in order.
group.steps: Steps `{ method, payload? }` in order.
group.options: Batch options such as `timeoutMs` and `signal`.
One outcome per step (success value or error).

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content: Identifies the package that created a remote-execution error. When handling a caught error, first compare its source with RPC_REMOTE_ERROR_SOURCE, then inspect code to choose how to respond. The same code text in another package need not mean the same failure.

symbols.purpose: Names of the lifecycle events passed to `peer.on(name, listener)` and `host.thread.on()` / `host.process.on()`.
symbols.core:
ready: `ready`: a (new) generation completed its handshake and accepts calls.
exit: `exit`: the worker or process exited; see `reason`, `code`, `signal`.
degraded: `degraded`: some capability (such as exit observation) is not available.
restart: `restart`: the supervisor starts a new generation; `count` says how many so far.
terminal: `terminal`: the supervisor gave up restarting; create or replace the unit.
liquidated: `liquidated`: the process resilience layer removed the registration; it cannot restart.

ready: `ready`: a (new) generation completed its handshake and accepts calls.
exit: `exit`: the worker or process exited; see `reason`, `code`, `signal`.
degraded: `degraded`: some capability (such as exit observation) is not available.
restart: `restart`: the supervisor starts a new generation; `count` says how many so far.
terminal: `terminal`: the supervisor gave up restarting; create or replace the unit.
liquidated: `liquidated`: the process resilience layer removed the registration; it cannot restart.

blocks.text: 错误保留原生类型、message、stack 与 cause；错误形状用 IRpcError，平台/拓扑值域用 IRpcPlatformValue / IRpcTransportTopologyValue。按稳定 source/code 而非 message 分支，远端身份只作诊断，不授予本地控制权。

isRpcErrorInstance / isRpcRemoteError / isRpcTimeoutError 按稳定字段跨 realm/副本判断，不能依赖 instanceof；isRpcError 只检查字符串 code，不能替代错误族守卫。RpcError、RpcRemoteError、RpcTimeoutError 等仅类型导出，唯一公开可构造类为 RpcLifecycleError，供持有自身释放状态的消费方使用。

blocks.text: 错误保留原生类型、message、stack 与 cause；错误形状用 IRpcError，平台/拓扑值域用 IRpcPlatformValue / IRpcTransportTopologyValue。按稳定 source/code 而非 message 分支，远端身份只作诊断，不授予本地控制权。

isRpcErrorInstance / isRpcRemoteError / isRpcTimeoutError 按稳定字段跨 realm/副本判断，不能依赖 instanceof；isRpcError 只检查字符串 code，不能替代错误族守卫。RpcError、RpcRemoteError、RpcTimeoutError 等仅类型导出，唯一公开可构造类为 RpcLifecycleError，供持有自身释放状态的消费方使用。

blocks.text: 认证 reason 为 RpcAuthenticationRejectionReason.sessionUnknown（重新发现会话）或 challengeInvalid（修正帧）。手动 connect.query 取消保留原生 DOMException/AbortError，CANCELLED 的 cause 指向 signal.reason。Core serializeRpcError/deserializeRpcError 还保留本层脱敏与转发路由元数据；树结构与 JSON-RPC 映射由 rpc-contract 拥有。

symbols.core:
send: Sends one actual carrier value; completion means the physical boundary completed, not that a remote provider executed.
send.message: Original complete message value accepted by this actual carrier domain.
send.options: Optional IRpcSendOptions supplies original physical transfer references.
Void or Promise<void> from the physical owner; native message-port and Worker send failures retain native Error/DOMException type and stack. Mutable unclassified errors gain Core TRANSPORT in place; foreign semantic identities stay unchanged, and immutable values remain on cause.
subscribe: Subscribes to actual inbound messages; the original native registration is detached when its last logical listener leaves.
subscribe.listener: Application callback receives a record containing data and optional actual peerId/origin/source; return void. Adapter-owned listener errors use onListenerError.
Idempotent removal of this registration; native cleanup failure may throw and preserve retry ownership.
close: Retires this transport according to actual ownership; owned resources may be closed, borrowed resources retain their caller-owned native lifetime.
Void or Promise<void>; actual native cleanup failures remain observable. Consult the adapter-specific close policy.
onTransportError: Subscribes to original physical/read/terminal failures without treating them as application provider results.
onTransportError.listener: Application callback receives original unknown error, returns void; secondary failure is retained by the adapter reporter boundary.
Removal releases this failure observer only.
onListenerError: Subscribes to original message-listener or physical-observer callback failures independently of transport failure.
onListenerError.listener: Application callback receives original listener error and returns void; its own failure is collected by the original adapter.
Removal releases this diagnostic observer and may surface collected reporter failures.
observe: Installs original physical observation; replacing it retires the preceding observation generation without acquiring lifecycle ownership.
observe.probe: Actual IRpcCarrierProbe port supplied by the installed endpoint emitter.
Disposer retires only this observation generation, including when the same probe was later reinstalled.
peerId: Optional original peer identity attributed by the actual adapter; caller labels do not grant verified identity.
origin: Optional actual origin attributed by the adapter, not a caller assertion of trust.
platform: Actual carrier platform label for presentation and diagnostics.
topology: Actual peer topology supplied by the adapter.
encodedType: Actual accepted carrier encoding domain.
ownership: Actual original physical ownership determining cleanup responsibility.
sourceProof: Optional original adapter callback receives native source and optional origin, synchronously returns boolean; labels alone cannot replace this proof.
closed: True only when this adapter can prove no future message delivery; logical detach alone is insufficient.

blocks.text: 错误保留原生类型、message、stack 与 cause；错误形状用 IRpcError，平台/拓扑值域用 IRpcPlatformValue / IRpcTransportTopologyValue。按稳定 source/code 而非 message 分支，远端身份只作诊断，不授予本地控制权。

isRpcErrorInstance / isRpcRemoteError / isRpcTimeoutError 按稳定字段跨 realm/副本判断，不能依赖 instanceof；isRpcError 只检查字符串 code，不能替代错误族守卫。RpcError、RpcRemoteError、RpcTimeoutError 等仅类型导出，唯一公开可构造类为 RpcLifecycleError，供持有自身释放状态的消费方使用。
